description: Editing a segment and assigning speakers.

preconditions: Transcript segment exists; actor is the current secretary of the meeting.
New text differs from the stored text.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an existing segment; actorId: the current secretary; text: corrected sentence.
cases.return: Success with the segment id, the trimmed text and the edit time (MSG302 "Đã lưu đoạn gỡ băng.").
cases.log: Saved: segment text, editor and edit time; audit row records the corrected segment.

preconditions: Transcript segment exists; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an existing segment; actorId: the current secretary; text: blank.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG303 "Nội dung đoạn gỡ băng không hợp lệ."); errors[text] = ["Nội dung đoạn phải có từ 1 đến 8000 ký tự."]; nothing is saved.

preconditions: Transcript segment exists; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an existing segment; actorId: the current secretary; text: exactly 8000 characters.
cases.return: Success (MSG302); text at the limit is accepted.
cases.log: Saved: segment text, editor and edit time; audit row records the corrected segment.

preconditions: Transcript segment exists; actor takes part in the meeting but is not the secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an existing segment; actorId: a member who is not the secretary; text: corrected sentence.
cases.return: Failure Forbidden (MSG295 "Chỉ Thư ký cuộc họp được quản lý bản ghi."); nothing is saved.

preconditions: No segment exists for the id.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an unknown id; actorId: an active user; text: corrected sentence.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; answered as if the segment does not exist.

preconditions: Transcript segment exists; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an existing segment; actorId: the current secretary; text: corrected sentence.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed (MSG304 "Không lưu được thay đổi bản ghi. Vui lòng thử lại."); the edit is rolled back.
cases.exception: PersistenceException is caught inside the service.
cases.log: Error logged with the segment id.
